map.HDL 是「好胆固醇」具保护力，LDL 是「坏胆固醇」。LDL/HDL 低说明坏: HDL is the "good cholesterol" and is protective, while LDL is the "bad cholesterol". A low LDL/HDL means less bad cholesterol and relatively more good, so lower risk; looking at LDL alone misses the protection of HDL. Non-HDL-C covers all atherogenic lipoproteins and reflects risk more completely than LDL.
map.TG/HDL 升高常关联腹型肥胖、胰岛素抵抗与代谢综合征，是心血管与糖尿病风险的: A high TG/HDL is often associated with abdominal obesity, insulin resistance and metabolic syndrome, and is a simple indicator of cardiovascular and diabetes risk (ideally <2). Improve it by cutting refined carbohydrates, limiting alcohol, doing regular aerobic exercise and taking lipid-lowering therapy when needed.
